mapper.sql: SELECT r.outReqId AS outReqId, r.comId AS comId, c.comName AS comName, r.outDateWish AS outDateWish, r.outDttmReq AS outDttmReq, r.outDttmAppr AS outDttmAppr, r.isTempo AS isTempo, r.isDelete AS isDelete, /* 대표 상태: 코드와 한글값 모두 계산 */ CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'SHIPPED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'APPROVED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '검수중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN 'INSPECTING' ELSE 'REQUESTED' END AS status, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '출고완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '출고완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '승인완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '승인완료' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '반려' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '반려' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = '검수중' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '검수중' ELSE '승인대기' END AS statusValue FROM outboundrequest r LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.comId = r.comId LEFT JOIN outbounditems i ON i.outReqId = r.outReqId
mapper.select: WHERE r.outReqId = #{outReqId} GROUP BY r.outReqId, r.comId, c.comName, r.outDateWish, r.outDttmReq, r.outDttmAppr, r.isTempo, r.isDelete

SELECT s.stkId AS stkId, c.cfName AS cfName, c.cfCategory AS cfCategory, c.cfGrade AS cfGrade, w.whName AS whName, s.stkQuantity AS stkQuantity FROM stock s JOIN coffee c ON c.cfId = s.cfId JOIN location_places lp ON lp.lpId = s.lpId JOIN locations loc ON loc.lpId = lp.lpId JOIN warehouse w ON w.whId = loc.whId
AND w.whId IN ( SELECT wm.whId FROM warehouse_management wm WHERE wm.userId = #{userId} )
ORDER BY c.cfName ASC, s.stkId ASC

SELECT v.vehicleId AS vehicleId, v.vehicleModel AS vehicleModel, v.vehicleDesc AS vehicleDesc FROM vehicles v
AND v.vehicleId = (SELECT u.vehicleId FROM users u WHERE u.userId = #{userId})
ORDER BY v.vehicleId
SELECT m.managerId AS managerId, m.managerName AS managerName FROM managers m ORDER BY m.managerName
